verdict.rationale: Weave documents an evaluation workflow for comparing changes over time and identifying regressions, plus marketing claims of 'powerful evaluation comparisons and visualizations' and organization-wide leaderboards. However, the evidence does not show a side-by-side eval comparison view or how prompt and model versions are diffed against each other. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a side-by-side eval-run comparison UI, explicit per-prompt/model-version diffing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can compare eval runs side by side to catch regressions between prompt or model versions

citations.quote: Weave provides powerful evaluation comparisons and visualizations to catch regressions before they reach users
measure your LLM application’s performance against repeatable test cases, compare changes over time, and identify regressions
Build rigorous, apples-to-apples evaluations for language model use cases
Aggregate evaluations into leaderboards featuring the best performers and share them across your organization.
